intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} are two of Chennai's best-known arts colleges, and both offer {{course}} programmes in {{cityA}}. This page compares recorded year fees, 2023 placements and India Today ranks from our database and official sites opened in {{year}}.
Loyola College vs MCC is a close local comparison, not a single-winner ranking. The India Today ranks on our records sit one place apart in 2024 and 2023.

sections.heading: Loyola College vs MCC for BA: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Loyola College if you want the recorded BA year totals of ₹26,600 for history and ₹29,220 for English literature, with a 2023 economics record of ₹3 lakh average and ₹10 lakh highest.

Choose Madras Christian College if you want the recorded year tuition of ₹18,719 across several BA subjects, with a 2023 English record of ₹3 lakh average and ₹7 lakh highest, and an India Today rank of 7 in 2024.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For Loyola College we hold Total Fees year figures of ₹26,600 for B.A History and ₹29,220 for B.A English Literature. Other listed BA programmes do not all have fee rows here, so confirm the official notice for every subject.
For MCC we hold ₹18,719 as tuition for one year on English, economics, philosophy, history, Tamil and political science. That is a year figure, not a confirmed three-year official total.
Confirm the current fee circulars on loyolacollege.edu and mcc.edu.in, including any shift or aided-versus-self-financing difference.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Loyola has a 2023 B.A Economics row of ₹3 lakh average and ₹10 lakh highest. MCC has a 2023 B.A English row of ₹3 lakh average and ₹7 lakh highest. These are historical records for those subjects, not a promise for every BA stream.
Many arts graduates also look at further study or civil-service exams. Ask both placement offices for a later official note if packages are central to your decision.

sections.heading: Admission, ranks and eligibility
paragraphs: No entrance exam is mapped on this page. Follow each college's official undergraduate admissions process, including any university counselling rules.
On our records, MCC has India Today ranks of 7 in 2024 and 2023, and 5 in 2021. Loyola has India Today ranks of 8 in 2024 and 2023. These are not NIRF ranks.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Chennai, so a local student can visit them on the same day.
Loyola lists several second-shift BA programmes as well as regular ones. MCC lists a slightly different subject mix, including philosophy and political science. Match the subject, not only the brand.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick Loyola College if that campus and the 2023 economics highest of ₹10 lakh matter more, after you confirm the official subject-wise fee.
Pick MCC if the recorded ₹18,719 year tuition, the India Today rank of 7, and that campus fit you better.
This is a close Chennai arts comparison. Let the exact BA subject and a campus visit decide, not a one-rank gap.

faqs.question: What BA fees are on record for Loyola College and MCC?
faqs.answer: Loyola has year totals of ₹26,600 for B.A History and ₹29,220 for B.A English Literature. MCC has year tuition of ₹18,719 on several BA subjects. Confirm official circulars for every stream.

faqs.question: How do 2023 placements compare?
faqs.answer: Loyola has a 2023 economics row of ₹3 lakh average and ₹10 lakh highest. MCC has a 2023 English row of ₹3 lakh average and ₹7 lakh highest. These are historical figures for those subjects.

faqs.question: Which college has the better India Today rank on this page?
faqs.answer: MCC is listed at 7 in 2024 and 2023. Loyola is listed at 8 in both years. The gap is one place, and these are not NIRF ranks.

faqs.question: Are both campuses in Chennai?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are recorded in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, as private arts and science colleges.

faqs.question: Do they offer the same BA subjects?
faqs.answer: They overlap in economics, English and history. MCC also lists philosophy, political science and Tamil. Loyola also lists sociology and some second-shift programmes.

faqs.question: Is an entrance exam listed?
faqs.answer: No exam is mapped on this page. Follow each college's official undergraduate admissions process.
